name: @wonjeongdae/design-system
description: 원정대 공통 브랜드 토큰, 테마, 웹 스타일 및 AI 적용 계약

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.react.json && node scripts/build-react.mjs && node scripts/build-react-demo.mjs && node scripts/build-figma.mjs && node scripts/build-hub.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node --import tsx --test tests/react.test.tsx && node tests/react-ssr.mjs
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.figma.json && tsc -p tsconfig.react.json --outDir .artifact-tmp/react-check && node scripts/check-react.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer.json && node scripts/build.mjs --check && node scripts/build-react.mjs --check && node scripts/build-figma.mjs --check && node scripts/build-hub.mjs --check
